scripts.heroku-postbuild: if [ "$PROJECT_TARGET" = "web" ]; then pnpm run build --filter=web; else pnpm --filter=@ai-standup/shared build && pnpm --filter=api exec prisma generate && (pnpm --filter=api exec prisma migrate deploy || true) && pnpm run build --filter=api; fi
scripts.start: if [ "$PROJECT_TARGET" = "web" ]; then npm --prefix apps/web run start; else node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const p = fs.existsSync('./apps/api/dist/main.js') ? './apps/api/dist/main.js' : './apps/api/dist/src/main.js'; console.log('Starting NestJS server from:', p); require(p);"; fi
